question: Choose the correct meaning of the idiom: **Fringe benefits**

options.text: Extra perks beyond a regular salary

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Extra perks beyond a regular salary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The idiom **"Fringe benefits"** refers to additional advantages or perks that employees receive besides their regular salary. These benefits may include health insurance, retirement plans, paid vacations, and other non-monetary incentives. (अतिरिक्त लाभ)

 

 
• **Example: **The company offers numerous fringe benefits, such as free gym memberships and annual bonuses, to keep employees satisfied.

 

 

 
• **Meaning in Hindi:** "Fringe benefits" का अर्थ है मुख्य वेतन के अलावा मिलने वाले अतिरिक्त लाभ।

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Extra perks beyond a regular salary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: A secret advantage** (गुप्त लाभ): Refers to a hidden or undisclosed benefit that someone has over others.

 

 
• **Example:** He had a secret advantage in the competition because he had trained with the best coach.

 

 

 
• **Option 3: The basic salary before taxes** (करों से पहले का मूल वेतन): Refers to the gross salary or the total earnings before any deductions like taxes or retirement contributions.

 

 
• **Example:** His basic salary before taxes is $50,000 per year.

 

 

 
• **Option 4: The minimal legal benefits** (न्यूनतम कानूनी लाभ): Refers to the least amount of benefits that employers are legally required to provide to employees, such as minimum wage or statutory leaves.

 

 
• **Example:** The company ensures all employees get the minimal legal benefits as per labor laws.
